semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The Oregon Business Development Department supports the semiconductor sector by fostering economic growth and innovation, attracting investments, and promoting advanced manufacturing technologies.
summary: The Oregon Business Development Department is focused on fostering economic growth and innovation within Oregon, particularly in the semiconductor sector. It provides resources and assistance to local entrepreneurs and businesses to enhance the semiconductor value chain and aims to attract investments and promote the development of advanced manufacturing technologies.
capabilities: Support for local entrepreneurs in the semiconductor sector

regional_presence.United States: The department is focused on strengthening Oregon's position in the global semiconductor market by fostering local economic growth and innovation.
